entities.summary: Prithu Gupta is an Indian chess grandmaster from Gurgaon, Haryana. He reached this milestone in July 2019, at the age of 15 years and 4 months, 31 years after Viswanathan Anand became India's first GM. He began playing chess when he was nine years old, which is relatively late compared to most other grandmasters.
